reviewNote: Wave 7 (docs/assets/reviews/crystal-material-fix.md) added a pale blue-white alpha-blended 'clear gem' material (baseColorFactor [0.86,0.92,0.96,0.42], alphaMode BLEND). Wave 8 visual review (docs/reviews/wave8-crystals-branchlab.md) rendered this derivative and found it CONDITIONAL -- washed-out/near-invisible at the back180 and side90 camera angles against the off-white review background. Wave 9 (crystal-material-fix.md addendum) fixed this with a contrast pass: baseColorFactor raised to [0.58,0.74,0.86,0.62] (higher alpha, deeper blue tint), metallicFactor 0.05->0.08, roughnessFactor 0.04->0.1; geometry/BIN chunk re-verified byte-identical to source. Wave 10 re-render (docs/reviews/wave10-contentnav-diamond.md, Part 2) confirmed the fix resolved the washed-out angles and upgraded the verdict to PASS. Wired into modelRegistry.ts and ChemistryLab.tsx's Crystal Structures mode in Wave 11.
